fullPassage: The central role of music and language in human existence and the fact that both involve complex and meaningful sound sequences naturally invite comparison between the two domains. Yet from the standpoint of modern cognitive science, music-language relations have barely begun to be explored. This situation appears to be poised to change rapidly, as researchers from diverse fields are increasingly drawn to this interdisciplinary enterprise. The appeal of such research is easy to understand. Humans are unparalleled in their ability to make sense out of sound. In many other branches of our experience (e.g., visual perception, touch), we can learn much from studying the behavior and brains of other animals because our experience is not that different from theirs. When it comes to language and music, however, our species is unique. This makes it difficult to gain insight into language or music as a cognitive system by comparing humans to other organisms.

questions.passage: When it comes to language and music, however, our species is unique. This makes it difficult to gain insight into language or music as a cognitive system by __________ (compare) humans to other organisms.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: compare → comparing: 전치사 by의 목적어이므로 동명사 형태
det.analysis: compare(동사) → comparing(동명사). 전치사 by 뒤에는 동명사가 와야 함. by comparing=비교함으로써
det.tip: 전치사 + 동명사(-ing). by comparing=~을 비교함으로써

questions.passage: This situation appears to be poised to change rapidly, as researchers from diverse fields are increasingly __________ (draw) to this interdisciplinary enterprise.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: draw → drawn: '이끌리다'라는 수동의 의미이므로 과거분사(are drawn)
det.analysis: draw(동사원형) → drawn(과거분사). 연구자들이 학제간 연구에 '이끌리는' 것이므로 수동태 be + p.p. 필요. be drawn to=~에 이끌리다

questions.passage: The central role of music and language in human existence and the fact that both involve complex and meaningful sound sequences naturally invite comparison between the two domains. Yet from the standpoint of modern cognitive science, music-language relations have barely begun to be explored. This situation appears to be poised to change rapidly, as researchers from diverse fields are increasingly drawn to this interdisciplinary enterprise. The appeal of such research is easy to understand. Humans are unparalleled in their ability to __________ sound. In many other branches of our experience (e.g., visual perception, touch), we can learn much from studying the behavior and brains of other animals because our experience is not that different from theirs. When it comes to language and music, however, our species is unique. This makes it difficult to gain insight into language or music as a cognitive system by comparing humans to other organisms.

✅ ③ make sense out of(~을 이해하다): 소리를 이해하는 능력 ← 정답
❌ ④ keep track of(~을 놓치지 않다): 문맥 부적합
